The Founder

Built by someone who
lived the problem.

Roman has been building and running operations his entire career. He founded Pavo Brewery from concept through revenue — full P&L, no outside backing. He then managed a Domino's Pizza branch in Israel, where fielding dozens of delivery and order calls per hour was the core of the job. That's how he learned firsthand how many businesses live and die by the phone.

Most recently, Roman spent 7 years as Operations Manager at Rosenstein & Associates, a Southern California law firm. Every night at 5pm the calls kept coming — and the firm had nothing but voicemail. He watched them lose clients they never knew they had. When AI voice technology matured enough to solve that problem at scale, he moved fast: SoCal Receptionist went from idea to a live platform with a paying client in under 90 days.

The Problem

Small businesses lose
customers every day
to missed calls.

A traditional receptionist costs $35,000–$45,000/year. Most small businesses can't afford one — so they miss calls, lose leads, and leave money on the table.

  • 📵 62% of calls to small businesses go unanswered Callers don't leave voicemails — they call the next result on Google.
  • 💸 Human receptionists cost $35K–$45K/year Plus benefits, training, turnover, and coverage gaps. Unaffordable for most SMBs.
  • ⏰ Calls arrive at 8pm, weekends, holidays After-hours inquiries — where 40% of new patient/client calls happen — go straight to voicemail.
